_readme: The Urgent fast path out of Intake (DRE-4150), on point 2 of the CEO's
signed console answer of 2026-09-17 09:57 PT, recorded on DRE-4141.
`ships_at` is the rule's ship moment: a card raised to Urgent (Linear
priority 1), or created at it, AFTER this moment may leave Intake for
Planning on the sweep's next pass. It is a DATED CONSTANT on purpose,
never 'now' — on 2026-09-17, 24 of 286 Intake cards already carried
Urgent, because on this board Urgent has meant 'important'. The rule
reads the ACT of raising a card after this moment off the card's own
Linear history, never the label it carries today.
`per_sweep_cap` is how many cards ONE sweep of the fleet may move, oldest
raised first; the rest wait for the next sweep and the run log names them.
`window_minutes` is what makes that cap hold ACROSS repos. Every product
repo's sweep reads the same Intake, so the cap is counted off the
fast-path receipts already posted anywhere on the board inside this
window, not off one sweep's own moves. Shorter than the fifteen-minute
cadence, so a repo's next sweep finds the window open again; long enough
to cover every repo's sweep that fired on the same schedule tick.
reads it as a file too.
